definition: Certified means: evaluated on the published tests for that capability, on a named model, with 95 percent confidence that at least 85 percent of runs pass (57 of the newest 60 for a single test), no single test below 80 percent, and the record published.
guarantee: The agent can only propose a change, never apply one: read-only access rights and a gateway that blocks writes.
